2438-3558-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
2438-3558-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

4681-5170-5332-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

907-2645-3430-7014.easyPrerequisites: North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
907-2645-3430-7014.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

628-3899-7187.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Hovel Hurler.
When Hovel Hurler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

240-4247-4885-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-3967-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1981-2415-3967-4446.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3967-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3967-6719.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

277-1479-5700-5701-7892.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-5700-5701-7892.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

511-817-4050-6441-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
511-817-4050-6441-7803.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2523-2869-7770.description:
Cast Ravenous Rotbelly by paying its mana cost.
When Ravenous Rotbelly enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When Ravenous Rotbelly dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Ravenous Rotbelly that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Ravenous Rotbelly token instead.

5147-7124-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
5147-7124-7659.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2724-4013-6432.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Eldrazi Displacer. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2595-6797--5.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1247-5390.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
457-1247-5390.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Pili-Pala, adding {U}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
457-1247-5390.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

2034-2267-3000-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2267-3000-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1395-4195-4574-4708.description:
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Dark Sphere from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

645-1267-5686-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-5686-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

1323-1336-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Heronblade Elite's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1534-6452.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with enough mana to cast it.
You have enough mana to cast Twincast
1534-6452.description:
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
If Adaptive Training Post had two charge counters on it, it triggers, putting a charge counter on it.
Holding priority, activate Adaptive Training Post by removing three charge counters from it, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn.
Cast Twincast by paying its mana cost, targeting the spell cast in step 1.
Adaptive Training Post triggers, copying Twincast, with the copy targeting the original Twincast.
Resolve the copy of Twincast, copying the original Twincast, with the copy targeting the original Twincast.
Repeat step 5.

225-1170-1645-5921-5954.notablePrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-1645-5921-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

64-4872-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Warden of the Eye each turn.
64-4872-6122.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Warden of the Eye by paying its mana cost.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Warden of the Eye from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

710-2921-5617.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

687-1628-2034-4350.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Tayam.
Butcher Ghoul does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
687-1628-2034-4350.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul, adding {C}{C}.
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its undying ability and Necrosynthesis trigger.
Resolve the Butcher Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Necrosynthesis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Tayam, and both counters from Butcher Ghoul.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Butcher Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

578-913-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Metalworker.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two artifact cards in hand.
578-913-3525.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, causing you to reveal at least two artifact cards from your hand and add at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

167-2493-4050.description:
Cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {B}.
When Archaeomancer dies, it and any Wicked Role tokens that may be attached to it trigger.
If applicable, resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped, and attaching a Wicked Role token to it.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Not Dead After All to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

383-1371-3948-4398.description:
Cast Neverending Torment.
Neverending Torment is exiled with Eye of the Storm.
Choose to not cast your copy of Neverending Torment with Eye of the Storm.
Hive Mind triggers, and all other players are forced to cast Neverending Torment.
All other players may not cast any other spells for the rest of the game because of Neverending Torment's Epic ability, and they can not use Enduring Ideal due to Stranglehold.
